notes: Harvest cap bound at 7.00 MJ; enforced with multiplier 1.875e-07 s/J after 11 DP solves.
baseline_statement: Gain is measured against uniform constant deployment at the same starting state of charge, both strategies required to end the lap with at least the energy they started with.
harvest_cap_basis: 7 MJ qualifying-session cap (2026). SECONDARY source — not confirmed against an FIA document. The 8.5 MJ figure in Art. 5.4.10 is the race cap.
